title: A sufficiently positive ample twist of a coherent module is globally generated
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal L$ be an ample invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module in the absolute sense of Stacks Definition 01PS [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] (invertible as in [def-sc-invertible-module]), and let $\mathcal F$ be a finite type quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $\mathcal L^{\otimes d}$ for the $d$-fold tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Then there is an integer $d_0$ such that $\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L^{\otimes d}$ is generated by finitely many global sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections] for every $d\ge d_0$; this means that for some finite family of global sections the evaluation map from the direct sum of copies of $\mathcal O_X$ indexed by the family onto $\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L^{\otimes d}$ is a sheaf epimorphism.

source.place: EGA II, Proposition 4.5.5, implication 'L ample ⇒ d)' (last paragraph of the proof); equivalently Stacks Properties, Proposition 01Q3 (label proposition-characterize-ample), (1) ⇒ (7)

proof.text: Use the compactness clause of absolute ampleness and lem-weil-pbc-ample-scheme-separated. Reuse the proved lem-weil-pbc-ample-finite-common-power-cover to obtain m>0 and a finite affine cover by zero-locus complements of sections of L^m.

For each p in Fin m, set G_p=F tensor L^p. Its quasi-coherence is the proved source isQuasicoherent_tensorObj in ProjectionFormula. Finite type is proved explicitly in the private finiteType_tensor_invertible helper: refine a finite local-generating cover of F by trivializing opens of L^p, restrict its generators using overMap, and transport them across the tensor-with-a-trivial-module isomorphism. Finiteness of each family is preserved. Tensor powers of L are invertible by the proved source instances.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-affine-section-cover-twist-generation with M=L^m, G=G_p, and the same finite cover for every p. Obtain natural bounds K_p and finite generating families of G_p tensor (L^m)^k for all k>=K_p.

Put B=max_{p in Fin m} K_p and d0=mB in Z. For d in N with d>=d0, let p=d mod m and k=d/m. Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le gives k>=B, while Nat.mod_add_div gives p+mk=d. The associator, tensorPowMulIso and tensorPowAddIso identify (F tensor L^p) tensor (L^m)^k with F tensor L^d. Push the generating family forward along this isomorphism with GeneratingSections.ofEpi; its index type is unchanged and therefore remains finite.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 4.5.5, p. 85, last paragraph: common positive tensor degree, local-generator extension, then finitely many residue classes. Common cover reused from its proved node; fixed-cover extension split into its own node; locality of finite type and the final residue argument are proved in Lean.

split_report.summary: The statement cited def-sc-ample, which is defined only for proper schemes over a field (some power very ample) and does not fit an arbitrary scheme X nor the citer (X projective over a complete Noetherian ring A); replaced by a new definition node def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module (absolute ampleness, Stacks 01PS / EGA II 4.5.3), and added def-pc-scheme and def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product to stmt_deps; 'finitely many' global sections made explicit (def-weil-pbc-generating-sections is for finite families). Proof written in six steps following EGA II Prop. 4.5.5 (the direct route: finite affine cover by X_{f_i} of one common degree m, local finite generators, clearing denominators, residues mod m), which is the same argument as Stacks 01Q3 (1)⇒(5)⇒(7) without the detour through L^n globally generated and Modules 01BB. Reused lem-pc-section-clearing-denominators (Stacks 01PW, closed Lean exists_tensorPowSection_eq_restrict on slopmaster2), lem-weil-pbc-nonvanishing-section-trivializes; created def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module, lem-weil-pbc-ample-scheme-separated (Stacks 09MP), lem-weil-pbc-affine-finite-type-generating-sections (Stacks 01PB + 01IA, EGA I 1.3.13), all searched in Mathlib with no match.

reviewed.note: Six steps along EGA II 4.5.5 / Stacks 01Q3 (1)=>(7): X quasi-compact and separated (new unsplit 09MP node), a finite affine cover by X_{g_i} with all g_i in one power L^m, local generators on affines (new unsplit 01PB node), extension after clearing denominators (existing imported 01PW node), global generation of the twists by mk via the trivialization tool, all large d by the residues mod m.
